why: Loose string tables of the localized masters the content tools read whose names are not in Skyrim's archives (#2899). Build-LastPlugin.py copies records from every master in game\data\last-plugin.json, and a localized master keeps its names in a .STRINGS, .DLSTRINGS and .ILSTRINGS file. Measured 20 Oct 2026: of those masters, Skyrim's five and RaceCompatibility.esm are localized; Skyrim's tables are in Skyrim - Interface.bsa, and RaceCompatibility's are loose in the game's Data\Strings, in no archive. scripts\mods\Send-GameArchives.ps1 sends each file named here, held to these bytes, to the box's C:\Thornswood-GameData\Strings, and Run-OnBox.ps1 links them into a run. Changed by hand, in a pull request, when a localized master that keeps its tables loose joins the last plugin's masters (Build-LastPlugin stops with 'no strings for <plugin>' until it is).
